stories.name: Oracle data center force majeure
stories.blurb: Oracle invoked a force majeure clause on a controversial New Mexico AI data center project, raising investor concerns about delays and costs that sent its stock falling.

stories.name: Bloom Energy AI power
stories.blurb: Bloom Energy's fuel cell business is surging on AI data center power demand, though questions remain about delayed projects and whether the stock's massive rally can continue.

stories.name: Oracle Market Forecasts
stories.blurb: A collection of market research reports projecting rapid growth across digital transformation, AI, healthcare IT, and related technology sectors, with Oracle listed among the key vendors profiled.

stories.name: Oracle Stock Slump
stories.blurb: After Oracle's stock plunged to 52-week lows following disappointing earnings, analysts and investors debate whether the sharp decline represents a buying opportunity given Wall Street's bullish price

stories.name: Adobe stock outlook
stories.blurb: A series of headlines debating whether Adobe's stock is a bargain or still risky as it bets on freemium growth.

past.name: AI debt bubble
past.blurb: Investors and analysts are warning that massive AI infrastructure spending, increasingly funded by debt and off-balance-sheet commitments, could pose serious credit risks to Big Tech.

past.name: Oracle data center delay
past.blurb: Oracle's data center delays and force majeure are weighing on tech stocks amid rising Treasury yields and oil prices.

past.name: Oracle Q1 Earnings Beat
past.blurb: Oracle's fiscal Q1 results topped analyst expectations, driven by surging cloud infrastructure and AI-related demand, prompting raised profit guidance and a jump in its stock price.

4.text: Oracle shares fell sharply amid rising AI-infrastructure borrowing costs, credit-default insurance, and rate concerns, including an 8.83% drop on October 14. Project Jupiter faced emissions and pipeline-approval issues, while Oracle reported negative $5.4B free cash flow amid $90–95B capex guidance.

8.text: Bloom Energy’s fuel cells are seeing strong AI data-center demand, including a contract central to Oracle’s AI ambitions, and Oracle reaffirmed its role in Project Jupiter. Analysts raised Bloom’s price target ahead of Q3 results, while DTE Energy signed Oracle and Google agreements.

7.text: Oracle is named as a vendor in market forecasts for life science analytics, life sciences IT, and retail analytics, and Vertex launched its tax engine on Oracle Cloud and Marketplace. LogiVeo will sponsor Oracle NetSuite's SuiteWorld 2026.

5.text: Oracle’s stock fell sharply, including a 9% drop, amid a tech selloff, AI buildout financing worries, and hotter 3.7% September inflation, even as analysts reiterated Buy ratings. Oracle reported 30% revenue growth, 121% OCI growth, and a record $664 billion backlog, though shares remain near yearly lows.
